title: Stars with common names
description: Returns all stars that have a proper (common) name.
query: query { stars(where: { proper: { not: "" } }, limit: 100) { proper con spect mag dist lum } }

title: Stars in a constellation (e.g. Ori)
description: Returns stars in a given constellation with key properties.
query: query { stars(where: { con: { eq: "Ori" } }, limit: 50) { proper spect mag dist lum bayer flam } }

title: Look up a star by name (e.g. Sirius)
description: Returns full details for a named star.
query: query { stars(where: { proper: { eq: "Sirius" } }, limit: 1) { proper con spect mag dist lum ra dec ci bayer flam } }

title: Stars by spectral type (e.g. G2V-type)
description: Returns stars matching a spectral type prefix.
query: query { stars(where: { spect: { eq: "G2V" } }, limit: 50) { proper spect mag dist lum con } }

title: Nearest stars to Sol
query: query { stars(where: { dist: { lt: 5.0 } }, limit: 50) { proper spect mag dist lum con gl } }

title: Brightest stars by apparent magnitude
query: query { stars(where: { mag: { lt: 1.0 } }, limit: 50) { proper spect mag dist lum con bayer } }

title: Most luminous stars
description: Returns stars with luminosity greater than 10000 Solar luminosities.
query: query { stars(where: { lum: { gt: 10000.0 } }, limit: 50) { proper spect mag dist lum con } }

title: Variable stars
description: Returns stars with a variable star designation.
query: query { stars(where: { var: { not: "" } }, limit: 50) { proper var var_min var_max spect mag con } }

title: Stars in multiple star systems
description: Returns stars that are part of a multi-star system.
query: query { stars(where: { base: { not: "" } }, limit: 50) { proper base comp comp_primary spect mag con } }

title: Look up a star by Hipparcos ID (e.g. 32349 = Sirius)
description: Returns a star by its Hipparcos catalog number.
query: query { stars(where: { hip: { eq: 32349 } }, limit: 1) { proper hip hd hr spect mag dist lum con } }
